A '''head clan''' was a group of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] who led their community on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. Leadership was defined by the member with the shortest lifespan; when one member of the head clan died, the others were cast into the [[Bright Lands]], thus eliminating corruption and assassinations.<ref name="CSWE" />
